## Parental OpControl 0.17.21

- **New lock countdown pill.** The box above the taskbar clock is now a Luna-style pill: a calm Luna face, **Lock in**, and the time in Fredoka. It follows the child's My OpControl theme by default, or a fixed Night sky / Moon gray look. The right end runs past the screen edge so the slide never shows a gap.
- **Tuck it away.** After 5, 10 (default) or 30 seconds the pill slides to the side with a small bounce, leaving only the face. Hover slides it back out; it tucks again after the delay. When tucked, the face cross-fades into a small analog clock with the current time.
- **Under 5 minutes and last minute.** With less than five minutes left the pill slides out on its own, turns amber and Luna grimaces while glancing at the time. In the last minute it stays out, turns red, Luna looks frightened and shakes, and seconds always show.
- **Click to open.** Clicking the pill, tucked or not, opens My OpControl (or brings it to the front). Hover alone never opens anything.
- **New Timer tab in My OpControl.** Kids can choose whether the timer shows, whether seconds show, days (`1d 8h 45m`) or hours (`32:45`) style, My theme / Night / Gray, and the tuck delay. A live preview follows the settings. Settings are saved for that Windows user only.
- **Warnings stay on.** The 5-minute and 1-minute heads-ups still appear even when the timer is hidden. Nothing here changes schedules, limits or the lock itself.
- Reduced motion is respected: no shake, glance, bounce or clock ticking; the states still change.
